_meta.title: MCP server recommendations — stack signal → server map
_meta.notes: Derivative work — distilled from the upstream markdown into a structured signal→recommendation table for ai-kit's recommend-tools scorer. Re-vendor (refresh pin + content) only with explicit user confirmation.

recommendations.name: context7
recommendations.best_for: Projects using popular libraries/SDKs where Claude should code against up-to-date docs
recommendations.value: Live documentation lookups instead of relying on training data — reduces hallucinated APIs and outdated patterns.

recommendations.name: playwright
recommendations.best_for: Frontend projects needing browser automation, testing, or screenshots
recommendations.value: Claude can interact with the running app, take screenshots, fill forms, verify UI.

recommendations.name: puppeteer
recommendations.best_for: Headless browser automation, web scraping
recommendations.value: PDF generation, scraping, headless CI tests.

recommendations.name: supabase
recommendations.best_for: Projects using Supabase for backend/database
recommendations.value: Query tables, manage auth, interact with Supabase storage directly.

recommendations.name: postgresql
recommendations.best_for: Direct PostgreSQL database access (no ORM, raw migrations, data analysis)
recommendations.value: Inspect schema, run queries, debug data issues directly.

recommendations.name: github
recommendations.best_for: GitHub-hosted repos needing issue/PR integration
recommendations.value: Create issues, review PRs, check workflow runs, manage releases.

recommendations.name: gitlab
recommendations.best_for: GitLab-hosted repositories

recommendations.name: linear
recommendations.best_for: Teams using Linear for issue tracking

recommendations.name: aws
recommendations.best_for: AWS infrastructure management

recommendations.name: cloudflare
recommendations.best_for: Cloudflare Workers, Pages, R2, D1

recommendations.name: vercel
recommendations.best_for: Vercel deployment and configuration

recommendations.name: sentry
recommendations.best_for: Error tracking and debugging
recommendations.value: Investigate Sentry issues, find root causes, suggest fixes.

recommendations.name: slack
recommendations.best_for: Slack workspace integration — notifications, deploy alerts, incident posts

recommendations.name: docker
recommendations.best_for: Container management — Compose, builds, debug

recommendations.name: kubernetes
recommendations.best_for: Kubernetes cluster management

recommendations.name: obsidian
recommendations.best_for: Projects with an Obsidian vault — markdown notes, PARA/Zettelkasten knowledge bases
recommendations.value: Read/write notes, query backlinks and dataview, surface relevant pages without leaving Claude.

recommendations.name: notion
recommendations.best_for: Teams using Notion for docs, PRDs, or roadmap
recommendations.value: Read pages and databases, append blocks, sync ADRs or roadmap entries without context switching.

recommendations.name: figma
recommendations.best_for: Frontend projects with Figma design files in scope
recommendations.value: Inspect frames, extract design tokens, sync component props from design source-of-truth.

recommendations.name: stripe
recommendations.best_for: Projects integrating Stripe for payments, subscriptions, or invoicing
recommendations.value: Inspect customers, payments, subscriptions; debug webhook failures and reconcile data.

recommendations.name: mongodb
recommendations.best_for: Direct MongoDB access (no ORM, raw aggregation, schema inspection)
recommendations.value: Run queries and aggregations, inspect indexes, debug data issues directly.

recommendations.name: redis
recommendations.best_for: Projects using Redis for cache, queues, pub/sub, or rate limiting
recommendations.value: Inspect keys, debug cache state, monitor pub/sub, troubleshoot stuck jobs.

recommendations.name: mysql
recommendations.best_for: Direct MySQL/MariaDB access (no ORM, raw migrations, data analysis)
recommendations.value: Inspect schema, run queries, debug data issues directly.

recommendations.name: firecrawl
recommendations.best_for: Projects needing live web scraping, competitive research, or doc ingestion
recommendations.value: Crawl and structure web content for LLM ingestion — superior to ad-hoc fetch.

recommendations.name: exa
recommendations.best_for: Projects needing semantic web search instead of keyword search
recommendations.value: Neural search across the web — finds conceptual matches keyword search misses.
